title: AI-Native SDLC: Building a Modern Software Lifecycle
metaDescription: Discover how to move beyond basic autocomplete and natively embed AI across your entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) for maximum speed and scale.
summary: This article explores the evolution of software development from bolt-on AI tools to an AI-native Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). It provides a comprehensive blueprint for integrating machine intelligence across every phase, from ideation and context-aware coding to autonomous pipelines and production observability.
